scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@riverside/shared && concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=@riverside/backend" "npm run dev --workspace=@riverside/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@riverside/shared && npm run build --workspace=@riverside/backend && npm run build --workspace=@riverside/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@riverside/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.validate: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build
